instructions: Read docs/CLINICAL_AUDIT_V3.md completely before execution.
Verify base SHA f5a967c89a7e8a222abf11e37ab9a4ca796d300a and create antigravity/radar-20260923-004.
Do not use Prima.
Remove four-phase score fusion from the primary RADAR interpretation path.
Choose one primary suitable contrast-enhanced portal-venous/venous phase for RADAR inference when available.
Other phases may be shown only as supplementary review images or explicitly experimental inference and must not change the primary RADAR score.
Remove forced Top-12 abnormality selection.
Default candidate list must use score >= 0.5 only as a positive-vs-negative prompt preference boundary, with a prominent warning that it is not a validated clinical diagnostic threshold.
Do not insert any unreviewed candidate into the formal KỸ THUẬT/MÔ TẢ/KẾT LUẬN layer. Formal report content should be generated from radiologist-accepted candidates plus manual notes.
Remove fixed ORGAN_ANATOMICAL_Z_RATIO evidence for finding-specific images.
Instrument inference_4060.py to capture per-window finding-score provenance and relevant organ segmentation metadata with minimal memory overhead.
For each candidate, select the exact highest-scoring contributing window and representative slice based on organ-mask area within that window.
If spatial provenance is unavailable, explicitly state no reliable spatial evidence instead of showing an arbitrary organ slice.
Canonicalize NIfTI orientation using affine/direction before rendering and use literal R/L markers. Add synthetic orientation-flip tests.
Use physical coordinates derived from image geometry rather than estimated slice position.
Separate primary model evidence from supplementary clinically useful phase images.
Add a RADAR-146 coverage matrix and prohibit unsupported normal statements for structures not represented by RADAR.
Preserve the user's conventional Vietnamese report structure as a formatting template only, not as automatic normal ground truth.
Run all synthetic/public demo tests.
Then re-run LOCAL_CASE_001 locally from the existing local alias using the corrected V3 workflow.
Produce one local V3 HTML and a local-only audit table. Do not upload patient findings, scores, images, DICOM, NIfTI, HTML, or audit table to GitHub.
GitHub terminal result may contain only aggregate non-PHI facts: primary phase class, candidate count, evidence provenance success count, orientation tests, runtime, peak VRAM, and pass/fail.
Open a new PR but do not merge.
